exports.name: ToastrService
exports.summary:
Displays toast notifications (success/error/info/warning), with deduplication,
max-opened limiting, and manual clear/remove control.
exports.summaryZh: 展示 toast 通知（成功/错误/提示/警告），支持去重、最大展示数量限制，以及手动清除/移除。

methods.name: show
methods.description: Shows a toast of a custom/blank type.
methods.descriptionZh: 显示一个自定义/空类型的 toast。

methods.name: success
methods.description: Shows a success toast.
methods.descriptionZh: 显示一个成功类型的 toast。

methods.name: error
methods.description: Shows an error toast.
methods.descriptionZh: 显示一个错误类型的 toast。

methods.description: Shows an info toast.
methods.descriptionZh: 显示一个提示类型的 toast。

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Shows a warning toast.
methods.descriptionZh: 显示一个警告类型的 toast。

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Remove all or a single toast by id.
methods.descriptionZh: 移除全部 toast，或按 id 移除单个 toast。

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove and destroy a single toast by id.
methods.descriptionZh: 按 id 移除并销毁单个 toast。

methods.name: findDuplicate
methods.description:
Finds a currently-displayed toast with the same title/message (used to avoid stacking
duplicate notifications), optionally resetting its timeout or bumping its duplicate count.
methods.descriptionZh:
查找当前已展示的、标题/消息相同的提示（用于避免重复堆叠通知），
可选地重置其超时时间或增加其重复计数。

properties.name: toastrConfig
properties.description: Property `toastrConfig` (`GlobalConfig`) storing toastr config.
properties.descriptionZh: 当前生效的全局配置（默认配置与模块注册时传入的配置合并后的结果）。

properties.name: currentlyActive
properties.description: Property `currentlyActive` (`number`) storing currently active (default: `0`).
properties.descriptionZh: 当前处于激活（可见）状态的提示数量。

properties.name: toasts
properties.description: Property `toasts` (`ActiveToast<any>[]`) storing toasts (default: `[]`).
properties.descriptionZh: 当前已加入队列/展示中的全部提示。

properties.name: overlayContainer
properties.description: Property `overlayContainer` (`ToastContainerDirective`) storing overlay container.
properties.descriptionZh: 自定义的提示容器，未设置时使用默认的全局覆盖层容器。

properties.name: previousToastMessage
properties.description: Property `previousToastMessage` (`string | undefined`) storing previous toast message.
properties.descriptionZh: 上一条展示的提示消息文本（用于去重判断）。
